turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale, I have about twenty minutes. Owen's zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me, so I'd like to hear who decided that and on what basis.
I'm waiting, Hale. Who decided, and on what basis?
"Mm-hm" isn't an answer, Hale. I'm writing down that you had nothing to say. Either the zero comes off today, or you put on this desk whatever you're relying on.
Are you finished? Because I stopped listening about five minutes ago.
"I stopped listening about five minutes ago." I'm writing that down, Hale, word for word. Withdraw the zero, or my next stop is the principal's office.
